Horizn Studios KI Agent · AI says:
Return window: EU/UK customers have a 14-day statutory withdrawal period; additionally, all customers have a 30-day voluntary return right from receipt. Items must be unused, complete, and in original packaging for the voluntary right.
How to return: Register via our Return Portal before sending back or returning in a Flagship Store.
Refunds: Once the return reaches our warehouse and is inspected, we refund to the original payment method, usually within up to 8 business days.
Shipping costs & fees: If you return the entire order, we refund the cost of the cheapest standard shipping. If you keep at least one item, original shipping isn’t refunded. When using our prepaid label, a return fee may be deducted depending on your country.
Exceptions / late returns: In individual cases after 30 days, we may make an exception if the item is completely unused and in original packaging.
Incomplete refunds: They can result from staged processing of multiple parcels, return shipping fees, special conditions for Switzerland, or discount conditions no longer being met.
